QuestInfo.parent: A Gift for a Citizen of Honor
QuestInfo.name: A Memory Restored
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p208# is about to show off his skill.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p208##k of #m10001040#, true to his reputation as the town's finest craftsman, repaired  #b#p221##k's bow to perfection. All that's left now is to bring this #b#t4031125##k back to #b#p221##k.  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I brought #t4031125# to #p221# and got to hear her story. That bow once belonged to a friend of hers from back when even #p221# herself was still young and inexperienced — he'd passed away in a war fought centuries ago, and #p221# had kept his bow all this time to remember him by. #p221# thanked me for helping her recover a bow that held such precious memories, and gave me a small gift in return. I should treasure this #b#t1032021##k she gave me too.

0.0: Whew... Here you go, please take this #b#t4031125##k. Thanks to the materials you brought me, it wasn't as difficult as I'd expected. Now, please bring this to #p221#.

yes.0: Still, I do wonder who made this bow, and where...?

1.0: Oh, you're back! Yes... this is indeed the bow I remember. I can feel the care that went into repairing what was broken while still keeping its original form as intact as possible. #p208# truly is our finest woodworking craftsman.
1.1: Since you've helped me this much, I suppose it's time I told you a secret. This bow, you see, isn't actually mine. It belonged to a friend of mine, from long ago, back when I too was just another archer dreaming of becoming a hero. Lian... that's a name I haven't spoken to anyone in a very long time.
1.2: He was shy and kind, and yet in battle, he was the kind of companion you could always rely on, someone truly steadfast. That is, until he was gravely wounded and passed away in a war fought centuries ago.
1.3: After that, I placed his bow in a box and buried it somewhere no one would ever find it, keeping it as a memory just for myself. But today, you've brought that precious memory back to me once again.
1.4: This is the first time I've ever told anyone something so personal. Well, that's enough of a dull old story. Let me give you the gift I promised. Here, please take this #b#t1032021##k.
1.5: Thank you so much for staying by this town's side. And I do hope we'll be able to stay together for a long time yet to come. Please, always take care of yourself.

item.0: Oh, you're back. But has #p208# not finished repairing my bow yet?

lost.0: I had a feeling you'd be back. See, I found this #b#t4031125##k lying on the ground. This took a lot of work to fix, so please, do take good care of it.
